rationale: ⲕⲙ̄ⲧⲟ = standard 'earthquake' (Crum); ⲥⲱⲱϩ tentatively from ⲥⲱⲟⲩϩ 'gather, cluster' — referring to a recurring/clustered seismic event at a specific cosmic level. The chapter heading frames the topic.
ⲕⲁⲥ 'bone' here used anatomically for cosmic structural levels of the Omophoros — 'the third bone' = third joint/segment of the cosmic Atlas. The cosmos has skeletal articulation.

Unidentified lexeme. Pairs with verb ⲟⲩⲉⲛ 'open' (line 5) and ⲥⲱϣⲧ 'block/stop' (line 2) — semantic field of openings/closures. Possibly related to ⲥⲗⲏ 'lock, bolt' or ⲥⲗⲱⲗⲙ̄ 'channel.' Confidence low.

Coptic ⲕⲣⲁϩ — likely a sound/disturbance noun related to ⲕⲣⲱⲍ 'shake' or ⲕⲱⲣϩ 'thunder.' Paired with ⲡⲕⲙⲧⲟ 'earthquake' (line 24) as a doublet of cosmic disturbance. Also paired with ⲃⲉⲟ̄ⲥⲉ 'weariness' (line 14) — fits 'groaning of the weary.'

Probably from a root meaning weariness/exhaustion. Context: weariness occurs in those keeping watch over the cosmic Zone, leading to the earthquake-disturbances. Fits Manichaean cosmology of overburdened bearers.
Lyc variant of ϩⲉ/ⲣⲏⲧⲉ 'manner.' Used in 'in this manner' (ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲣⲏⲧⲉ) line 28.
Distinct register from cosmological 'Ancient One.' In body-context of this kephalaion, ⲣⲙⲛⲉⲥ = the unredeemed Old Man (παλαιὸς ἄνθρωπος of Romans 6:6, Eph 4:22) mounted upon the body alongside Sin.

Two senses on this page: (1) line 29 paired with ⲥⲁⲏ 'wisdom' — discernment/knowledge revealed to powers of light; (2) line 32 ϯ-ⲥⲟⲩⲓⲧⲉ ⲛ̄ϣⲱϩⲧ 'give the verdict of cutting' — punitive decree. Both senses share a 'discernment/judgment' core meaning.
Lyc form related to ⲥⲁϩ 'wise, teacher.' Distinct from ⲥⲃⲱ 'teaching.' Here paired with ⲥⲟⲩⲓⲧⲉ as a faculty revealed to the powers of light.
Lyc reflex of ⲥⲱⲡⲧ̄/ⲥⲃⲧⲉ 'be prepared, fitting.' Used adverbially: ⲥⲛ̄ ⲟⲩⲥⲉⲡⲧ ⲉϩⲥⲙⲁⲁⲛⲧ 'in due preparation, established' — describing the fitting and ordered action of the powers of light.
ϯ + ⲙⲁ = 'give place to' — judicial idiom for 'consign over to (a sentence/punishment).' Here: 'they consign to enmity' = deliver up to the verdict of enmity.
Lyc form of ϣⲱⲱⲧ 'cut, cut down.' Used as nominal: 'verdict of cutting' = decree of execution/destruction.
